name: ide-marksman
author: lumine-code
backgroundTips: {{packageName}} provides link completion, navigation, references, and refactoring whenever Markdown is open.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `marksman` executable. Leave empty to use the copy the editor installed, or the one on PATH.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of Marksman the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report broken, ambiguous, and duplicate wiki-link targets.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Complete Markdown links, reference links, wiki links, documents, and headings.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Preview the document or heading targeted by a link.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump from links and references to their targets.

references.title: Find References
references.description: List links that refer to a document or heading.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project headings to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with the document's heading hierarchy.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Rename documents and headings together with the links that target them.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Create or update a table of contents and create missing linked documents.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Show the number of references above each heading.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Apply server-computed highlighting to link destinations and headings.
